observed_implementation: DeploymentAPI.portfolio requests NFT detail at the latest confirmed state
It subsequently requests /v1/nfts/{id}/earnings at the latest confirmed state
It correctly rejects earnings when the returned block hash differs from the NFT-detail block hash
Earnings.read currently chooses a fresh latest snapshot and has no caller-selected fixed-block earnings route
risk: A new confirmed block between the two requests can make card earnings unavailable even when both individual replies are valid. The exact same-anchor check must remain; fixed-head local rehearsal does not qualify moving-head behavior.
safe_next_design: Add an explicit reviewed fixed-block earnings/card read capability with live canonical, depth and freshness checks; do not relax per-card anchor equality or use rolling latest totals.
runtime_claim: Source inspection only; no moving-head rehearsal executed
